_comment: Retention tiers for WHG authority namespaces, keyed by the prefix of a `whg_match_id`.
The tier controls what we may RETAIN from a matched record, never what we may QUERY.
See LICENSING-POLICY.md for the reasoning; WorldHistoricalGazetteer/place#240 for the origin.
`license_spdx` values are copied from the indexing repo's own registry
(processing/settings.py AUTHORITIES), which is authoritative — not from prose.
Anything absent from this file is treated as tier D (most restrictive). Adding a namespace
requires reading its actual terms, not guessing from a similar-looking one.

_tiers.A: Public domain or attribution-only. Geometry may be retained and published under CC BY 4.0, with attribution.
_tiers.B: Share-alike (ODbL / CC-BY-SA). Query and constrain freely; NEVER retain geometry — it would make our dataset a derivative database.
_tiers.C: Non-commercial or bespoke-restricted. Query and constrain freely; NEVER retain geometry — the restriction is incompatible with CC BY 4.0.
_tiers.D: No-derivatives, or terms unknown. Query and verify only; NEVER retain geometry. Merging is arguably the adaptation the licence forbids.
_tiers.E: Contributed WHG datasets. Tier is whatever the dataset's own recorded licence implies; with no recorded licence, treat as D.

ukhc.name: UK Historic Counties
ukhc.note: Bespoke terms. Grouped attribution-only in place#240; re-read the terms before any bulk adoption.

chgis.name: CHGIS (China Historical GIS)
chgis.note: Academic-use terms. The single most useful source for Qing-era Chinese containment: query and constrain with it, never adopt from it.

nl.name: Native Land Digital
nl.note: Data-sovereignty terms, not a standard licence. Never adopt; cite as a reference only.

dgsd.name: Digital Gazetteer of the Song Dynasty
dgsd.note: No-derivatives. Merging its geometry into our dataset is arguably the adaptation the licence forbids.

whg.name: Contributed WHG dataset
whg.note: Per-dataset. Until the contributing dataset's own licence is recorded and read, treat as D.

loc.name: Library of Congress
loc.note: Relations only — carries no geometry, so retention never arises.
